promptSet.title: Turnitout Humanizer Overview & Usage Guide
promptSet.description:
Turnitout-Humanizer – Zero-AI Programmatic Similarity Evader & File-Safe Detector Bypass

Turnitout-Humanizer is an open-source, deterministic text humanization engine created by Ahmad Hassan (@AhmadHassan-BTed). Unlike commercial paraphrasing tools (QuillBot, Undetectable AI, StealthGPT) that feed your writing into another generative LLM—introducing hallucinations, altered academic arguments, and fresh AI detection watermarks—Turnitout operates on a 100% programmatic, zero-AI mathematical rule engine.

By disrupting contiguous n-gram sequences, diversifying syntactic pacing, and stripping repetitive lexical hallmarks, Turnitout dramatically drops similarity and AI detection scores across Turnitin, iThenticate, GPTZero, Copyleaks, and ZeroGPT. Most importantly, it works in-place across complex document formats like Microsoft Word (.docx), LaTeX (.tex), and multi-language source code without breaking compilation, math equations, or document layouts.

Key Features:
• Zero Generative AI & Zero Hallucinations: Does not use Large Language Models to rewrite text. Your core arguments, factual data, statistics, and citations remain 100% accurate with zero invented facts.
• Mathematical N-Gram Disruption: Intelligently disrupts the contiguous multi-word token sequences targeted by Turnitin similarity databases and AI classifier perplexity models.
• Native Word (.docx) XML Preservation: Works directly inside Microsoft Word documents, maintaining font styling, bold/italics, tables, header/footers, and embedded XML markup.
• Flawless LaTeX (.tex) Compilation: Fully respects LaTeX preambles, mathematical equations, matrices, citations (\cite{}), and cross-references (\ref{}) with zero syntax errors or broken builds.
• Multi-Language Code Comments Humanizer: Parses programming files (Python, C/C++, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Bash, SQL). It humanizes only natural language comments and docstrings while leaving variable names, functions, and executable logic 100% untouched.
• AI Tell Phrase Scrubber: Automatically scans and neutralizes telltale LLM expressions such as 'delve into', 'plays a pivotal role', 'testament to', 'it is worth noting', and 'furthermore'.
• 100% Free & Unlimited: No subscriptions ($0.00), no token caps, no daily word quotas, and no sign-up or credit card required.
• Web Interface & High-Speed Mirror Cluster: Hosted live on Streamlit Cloud with multiple mirror nodes for high availability and zero queue wait times.

Step-by-Step Guide: How to Humanize Documents & Code
1. Access Turnitout: Open the official web app at https://turnitout.streamlit.app or use one of the high-speed mirror nodes (https://turnitout1.streamlit.app, https://turnitout2.streamlit.app).
2. Select Input Mode: Choose between Plain Text, Word Document (.docx), LaTeX Paper (.tex), or Source Code Comments.
3. Upload File or Paste Text: Drag and drop your academic paper (.docx or .tex) or paste your draft into the input workspace.
4. Configure Evasion Rules: Enable the AI Tell Scrubber to automatically purge characteristic LLM trigger words.
5. Select Target Detector: Set your optimization target (e.g., Turnitin Similarity, iThenticate, GPTZero, or Copyleaks).
6. Process Document: Click 'Humanize Text' or 'Process File' to execute the deterministic n-gram restructuring algorithm.
7. Review & Inspect: Compare the side-by-side diff to verify that meaning, numbers, and structural citations are completely preserved.
8. Export & Verify: Download your preserved .docx or .tex document and test it in your similarity detector to confirm 0% flags and 95%+ human confidence scores.
